reference_sql:
SELECT order_month, SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY order_month
ORDER BY order_month
alternatives: SELECT order_month, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month ASC
SELECT order_month, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT order_month, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_month IN (DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-02-01', DATE '2025-03-01') GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

other_way.sql: SELECT order_month, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales WHERE order_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Filters on the month column, which is short, but only works when the range is whole months.
